_comment: Pad map for pwm8_spi in SCL's 5 mm frame (frame5mmx5mm_opad: the 10 output pads listed here swapped from AIPAD00 to OPAD04, everything else as SCL placed it). Core-block port -> frame net. Matches rtl/chip/pwm8_spi_chip.v and docs/spec.md 'Chip pinout'. PAD11 and PAD23 (frame corners) are not usable: their core-side pins do not reach the ring's inner edge.

power._comment: stripe_y_frame = frame y of the 20 um M1 stripe centre; must be a row-gap centre (core-local 219.15 + 97.4*k). To be checked at chip assembly.
